commits.subject: core: ARMv7 asm for Locked*() - in a single mormot.core.base.asmarm.inc
commits.body:
- as suggested in #644, mormot.core.base.asmaarch64.inc is renamed as
  mormot.core.base.asmarm.inc, which now includes the ARMv7 asm too
- ARMv7 has no store-release STLEX, so the LDREX/STREX loops are surrounded
  by two DMB ISH, as the Linux kernel does on arm
- ASMARM is defined on aarch64, and on ARMv7+ (CPUARM_HAS_DMB): older ARM
  CPUs still use the RTL calls with ReadWriteBarrier
- on ARMv7, Locked*() are no longer inlined, so the "not inlined" notes
  about ReadWriteBarrier are gone
commits.author: zen010101
